"To commemorate the 3D figure release, I’m making public the lewd 4-page competition swimsuit piece of Kasumi-san that I contributed to the Noto Peninsula Earthquake charity book a little over two years ago.

Since this was before I started the shrine maiden series, she was set up as a swimming instructor back then... You can already see hints of her masochism from this time...

I like all three of them now, but Kasumi-san’s image was the first one that really took shape for me, so as the author she’s a character I like quite a lot."
